Are you looking for an agile, efficient and affordable solution to take your business digital presence to the next level? Offshore Laravel development may be the perfect fit for you! This strong open-source PHP web framework allows for speedy development while reducing the need for a large set of resources. 

Laravel is a popular open-source PHP online application framework that has been lauded for its ease of use, sophistication, and speed. Laravel’s adoption rate has increased by more than 100% in the past year. 

As of 2021, Laravel accounts for approximately 25% of all new PHP projects. Laravel distinguishes itself from other PHP frameworks through its top-notch routing system, powerful ORM (Object-Relational Mapping), and extensive libraries. In addition, Laravel uses Symfony components as its foundation, giving it robust capabilities.

Benefits That Set Laravel Apart

  • Blade Template Engine: A simple yet extremely powerful templating engine that enhances developers’ work.
  • Artisan CLI: A robust and flexible command-line interface that helps developers to execute repetitive tasks with ease.
  • Laravel Libraries: A plethora of built-in libraries that provide everything developers need to create reliable and effective web applications.
  • Laravel Ecosystem: An active Laravel community that supports learning, sharing, and collaboration.

For their web development projects, many companies choose to hire offshore Laravel developers in order to take advantage of cost savings and access a larger talent pool.

Laravel Development Services

  • Laravel App Development: Cater to businesses looking to create custom web applications with unmatched features and functionality. Our skilled Laravel developers build agile, secure, and scalable apps that run seamlessly across different platforms.
  • Laravel Website Development: Help businesses create visually stunning and feature-packed websites that stand out from the competition. We use Laravel’s flexible templating engine, Blade, to build unique user interfaces and ensure superior performance.
  • Dedicated Laravel Developers: Such specialists possess a wealth of experience and expertise in Laravel and work exclusively on client projects. Our team comprises highly motivated Laravel developers offshore who are passionate about their craft and dedicated to delivering high-quality code.
  • Laravel Migration and Upgrade: Our Laravel experts provide migration and upgrade services to help businesses move their existing web applications to Laravel or upgrade their current Laravel application to the latest version. We ensure smooth and secure migration, minimizing downtime and potential data loss.
  • Laravel Support: Provide ongoing maintenance and support to businesses with Laravel applications. We offer comprehensive testing, debugging, and performance monitoring to ensure the application runs seamlessly all the time. Our Laravel experts are available 24/7 to provide quick and effective solutions to any issues that may arise.

Comparing the Expenses of In-House and Offshore Laravel Developers

Hiring offshore Laravel developers is essential for many businesses as it is a PHP framework that is widely used for different web development projects. But, when it comes to hiring developers, businesses encounter the dilemma of choosing between in-house and offshore development teams. Understanding the cost of Laravel developers for hire in different countries can help businesses make the right choice.

Laravel Developer Salaries: A Global Analysis

According to Salary.com, the average salary for Laravel developers in the United States is around $84,169 per year. However, different factors such as experience, skillset, and location can significantly affect the salary range. In Europe, the average salary for Laravel developers is around €48,908 per year. The average salary in India and Southeast Asia is around $15,000 per year.

Cost Comparison: In-House vs. Offshore Laravel Developer Salaries 

Factors Influencing Laravel Developer Compensation

Several factors can influence Laravel developers’ compensation, including experience, location, company size, and job requirements. Developers with extensive experience and expertise in Laravel may demand a higher salary or hourly rate. Depending on where the offshore Laravel development company is located, the cost of living may also affect the salary range. If you want to scale your tech team and optimize your development budget, consider the option to hire offshore backend developers.

The Value of Combining Onshore and Offshore Teams

Integrating offshore teams with in-house resources can offer a multitude of benefits for organizations. Here are some notable advantages that an organization can enjoy:

  • Better Communication: Collaborative tools such as video conferencing, instant messaging, and shared workspaces can help in bridging the communication gap between the offshore and in-house teams. Greater collaboration and transparency can lead to accelerated project timelines and increased productivity, with fewer chances of miscommunication.
  • Improved Coordination: Offshore team integration with in-house resources also helps in establishing a unified vision and goals across teams. This alignment ensures that all team members work towards the same objectives. The integration also promotes better task allocation and assistance to onboarded offshore team members.
  • Increased Efficiency: The integration of in-house and offshore teams leads to the synergistic leveraging of complementary skills and competencies, resulting in superior work quality and greater output capacity. The offshore team members often bring a fresh perspective and diverse experience to the table, adding to the richness of the overall team’s insights and ideas.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Integrating offshore teams with in-house resources not only supports knowledge-sharing but also facilitates skill development. It allows cross-pollination of best practices, lessons learned, and industry insight between the in-house and offshore teams. It can potentially lead to the upskilling of in-house teams and highly experienced, culturally and linguistically adept offshore team members.
